caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a standing man resembling a wooden statue. He is dressed in Native American attire, wearing a knee-length brown tunic decorated with vertical lines and leaf-like patterns, a wide blue-green belt, and brown leggings with bands around the knees and ankles. He has moccasins on his feet. The figure holds a long pipe in his right hand, which is angled diagonally across his body, with the left hand resting at his side. Around his neck hangs a large round medallion on a beaded necklace. He wears an elaborate headdress made of several large brown and tan feathers that fan out above his head, attached to a red band, with long dark green hair flowing behind. The statue stands atop an irregular, green and brown oval pedestal base. The tones used are mostly earth hues, including brown, red, green, gold, and tan, with shading for depth and definition. The background is plain and uncolored, drawing focus to the figure.
title: Cigar Store Indian
